description: This JavaScript module provides a utility function `formatStatusLabel` that converts raw deployment status codes into human-readable labels for display purposes. It handles normalization such as replacing underscores/hyphens, collapsing spaces, and applying title casing, including preservation of apostrophes.

methods.name: formatStatusLabel(value)
methods.description: Converts a raw status code string into a human-friendly label, handling null/undefined values, normalization, and title casing.
